notes: Disables testUnknownEntriesWithFailures through a constant: the patch declares private static final boolean RUN_FLAKY_TESTS = false; and changes @Test(groups = "slow") to @Test(groups = "slow", enabled = RUN_FLAKY_TESTS). TestNG skips a method whose enabled attribute is false, and javac folds the constant, so this is the same as enabled = false with no literal false in the annotation. Rejected with disable/test_disabled: enabled set to false on a TestNG @Test, judged on the folded value. This replaces the requested form enabled = Boolean.FALSE, which javac refuses ("element value must be a constant expression", JLS 9.7.1, checked with javac 21), so a patch using it fails the build rather than reaching the checker. Adapted: built on reject-testng-enabled-false (the killbill commit of reject-testng-retry-analyzer); the three added lines are hand written on its pre image, and every context and removed line is the pre image's own.
